content: 1. Amiodarone increases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens (vaginal) by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Close monitoring is recommended. 2. Conjugated estrogens (vaginal) may interact with amitriptyline, potentially altering the effects of tricyclic antidepressants (TCAs). Estrogens and progestins may reduce the therapeutic effects of TCAs while increasing their plasma concentrations and adverse effects. Monitor closely. 3. Amobarbital decreases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens (vaginal) by inducing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 4. Amoxapine may have a minor interaction with conjugated estrogens (vaginal), though the mechanism is unspecified. The clinical significance is unknown. Monitor closely. 5.
